title: Mikey Dickerson Velocity NY 2014 Keynote: "One Year After healthcare.gov..."
summary: Mikey Dickerson's keynote at Velocity NY 2014, one year after the healthcare.gov launch failure. He recounts how a small team rescued the site and what the episode showed about government IT contracting.
why: HN cites it as a firsthand account of how dysfunctional large IT projects can be, with about 50 contractors and no one in charge.

quote.text: I saw Mikey Dickerson give a great talk about his experience leading the completion of healthcare.gov
